value: Rec Room is a free, cross-platform social virtual world and game creation platform where users can connect with friends globally, explore millions of player-created rooms, and participate in diverse games. It empowers users to express their creativity by building their own experiences, from custom avatars to entire worlds, using intuitive tools like the Maker Pen. Committed to fostering a welcoming and inclusive community, Rec Room prioritizes user connection, promotes a bias towards action and continuous iteration, and ensures non-exploitative engagement. The platform further emphasizes user safety, notably offering a kidSAFE certified Junior Mode.
